events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis - Shipping Collapsed, Oil Rising
events.summary: Strait of Hormuz shipping has effectively collapsed since the Iran-US/Israel conflict began late February 2026. Brent crude near $85/bbl. Iran FM Araghchi says Hormuz will not reopen until US eases sanctions and pays war reparations. Houthis attacking Saudi oil tankers. Iran parliament reviewing ban on US/Israeli ships. Largest energy disruption in recorded history.

events.title: Historic US-Japan Joint Currency Intervention - FIMA Repo Upsized
events.summary: First-ever joint US-Japan FX intervention to prop up yen. Japan sold approximately $58.97B to buy yen. US Treasury Secretary Bessent participated, with note reading 'To Do Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil.' FIMA repo facility being upsized from $60B/day limit. BOJ kept rates at 1% (8-1 vote). Fed Chair Warsh signaling possible rate hike. BofA sees yen strengthening 6% by year-end.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - Fastest Growing on Record, WHO PHEIC Declared
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC and Uganda declared WHO PHEIC on May 16, 2026. ~1,916 confirmed deaths in DRC, 2 in Uganda. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record. WHO and Africa CDC conceded Aug 6 that outbreak is spreading faster than response efforts. New variant identified by Lancet researchers. Started in February, months before official declaration.

notes: Argentina-Brazil diplomatic crisis noted but not category-5. China property crisis ongoing but no new emergency. EM Asia currency defense noted (Bloomberg Aug 9) but not at crisis level. Africa: South Africa-Nigeria diplomatic tensions noted but not category-5. Financial system: regulatory oversight gaps noted (American Banker Aug 6) but no acute failure.
